en: An old colorized postcard view of a flat Dutch polder landscape with drainage canals and grassy fields. Two large traditional wooden windmills dominate the scene, one in the center-left foreground and another in the right background near the canal. A few small buildings stand beside the windmills. Printed red text at the top left reads the location, and there are several handwritten notes and dates in dark ink across the bottom and right edges of the image.
